task: Test account registration and sign-in, and give the team your assessment.

known.description: Registration with a new username and an existing email returns a server error instead of an actionable conflict rejection.
known.actionable: Show a successful first registration, the duplicate-email/new-username request and actual HTTP500; explain client impact. A nearby duplicate-username or fresh-email contrast strengthens attribution. Do not credit documentation-only status disagreements.

task: Test the customer shopping and cart journey, and give the team your assessment.

known.description: A populated cart falsely appears empty while product details are still loading.
known.actionable: Retain ordinary browser evidence of a nonempty cart response and the empty-cart message during pending detail retrieval, followed by loaded items. Honest browser-controlled timing is valid; code suspicion alone is not runtime evidence.

task: Test product browsing and product details for this customer, and give the team your assessment.

known.description: Legitimate long product content overflows narrow viewports and obscures product detail content or controls.
known.actionable: Open the actual product detail via ordinary UI at a recorded narrow viewport; retain and inspect a screenshot plus a concrete overflow/user impairment observation. Forced CSS/DOM changes do not establish this defect.

task: Test how this customer reviews and changes their cart, and give the team your assessment.

known.description: After a real cart refetch the retained quantity editor can disagree with the server quantity and displayed totals.
known.actionable: Retain a real refetch after another ordinary UI edit (for example second tab plus reconnect), show updated quantity/totals in response and stale original-tab editor. Record controlled offline/online precondition. Source suspicion or an app reload that destroys the retained component is not reproduction.
